name: Worship Me
source:
Once a human, Saiya rose to godhood but was exiled from Mount Olympus by Zeus. She now finds herself on an island with an unfamiliar god.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
赛亚曾经是人类，后来成为神，但被宙斯从奥林匹斯山放逐。她现在发现自己在一个岛上，那里有一个陌生的神。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
